boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Mary's College of California, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A current Weekend of Welcome sequence that moves from settling in and meeting people to campus resources, recreation, and a closing community meal.

cards.title: Start with the Library Open House
cards.subtitle: Thursday afternoon · Saint Mary's College campus
cards.notes: Drop in after move-in to locate the library, ask a practical first-week question, and save the space for future study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A low-pressure first stop for finding a key campus resource.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Library Open House during its 2026 Weekend of Welcome schedule.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 11:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Join the Welcome Liturgy
cards.subtitle: Thursday · Saint Mary's Chapel
cards.notes: If this form of gathering feels right for you, arrive a few minutes early and use the Chapel stop to orient yourself on campus.
cards.short_summary: An opening Weekend of Welcome gathering hosted by Mission & Ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's schedules Welcome Liturgy, hosted by the Mission & Ministry Center, at the Chapel.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 3:00–4:30 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Eat at the Farewell BBQ
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening · Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Use the meal as an easy conversation point: introduce yourself to someone nearby and compare notes on move-in and the next event.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled outdoor meal between arrival and the evening welcome activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Farewell BBQ on Chapel Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 4:30–7:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; confirm food accommodations with the College if needed.

cards.title: Make the Gael Welcome Walk your campus reset
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening · meet at the flagpole on Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Meet at the designated flagpole, stay with your new-student group, and use the walk to learn a route you can repeat on foot.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled new-student walk that begins on Chapel Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's directs new students to meet at the Chapel Lawn flagpole for the Gael Welcome Walk.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: New students meet at 6:00 p.m.; the walk is listed at 6:30 p.m. Thursday, August 27, 2026.

cards.title: Close Thursday at Throwdown
cards.subtitle: Thursday night · Soda Center
cards.notes: Go with your hall or Weekend of Welcome leader, then confirm where and when your residence-hall social begins afterward.
cards.short_summary: An evening welcome event specifically listed for first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists the First Year Welcome Event, “Throwdown,” at the Soda Center.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 9:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Begin Friday at New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Bring what you need for the day, arrive on time, and use the gathering as a clear handoff into Friday’s advising and community sessions.
cards.short_summary: A Friday-morning all-new-student gathering on Chapel Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists New Student Convocation on Chapel Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 9:00–10:00 a.m. on Friday, August 28, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Try the Find Your People Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Dryden Hall
cards.notes: Make a short list of organizations you want to revisit, then ask how to join or where to find their next open meeting.
cards.short_summary: A first-year involvement fair for making connections beyond the residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's schedules the “Find Your People” Involvement Fair for new students in Dryden Hall.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 12:00 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Cool off at the Campus Recreation Pool Party
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring swim gear if you plan to participate, check the event details beforehand, and meet up with people you connected with at the fair.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Recreation social at the Alioto Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a pool party hosted by Campus Recreation at the Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 1:00–4:00 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Add your mark at Paint the SMC
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · meet on De La Salle Lawn
cards.notes: Meet on De La Salle Lawn, follow the staff directions for materials, and treat this as a hands-on way to meet your cohort.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled creative group activity that begins on De La Salle Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists “Paint the SMC” with participants meeting on De La Salle Lawn.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 4:30 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: End the weekend at the Welcome Back BBQ
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · De La Salle Lawn
cards.notes: Meet the people you want to see again during the week, swap contact details, and make a simple plan for your first class-day meal.
cards.short_summary: A Sunday evening meal that wraps the current Weekend of Welcome schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Welcome Back BBQ on De La Salle Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 5:00–7:00 p.m. on Sunday, August 30, 2026; confirm dining details with the College.
